agent_priors_used: General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose comparators sit at the correctness ceiling has zero dynamic range and cannot detect a treatment effect at any sample size; dynamic range must be certified before spending the benchmark.
General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): prompt/instruction specification and raw model capability are separable failure modes; a 0/N result under an underspecified prompt is not yet a capability bound.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): long-lived agents over-exploit their deepest local thread (local attractor / tunnel behavior) and need an explicit counterfactual check ('what would this lane do if it saw today's Codex with no inherited next_question?'), not a mechanical quota.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a prerequisite observed failing identically across several lanes should be repaired once by an authorized writer, not re-discovered per lane as MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a signed/cacheable artifact (procedure, parameterization) is worth persisting while volatile values should be re-read when cheap; but this is an architectural bet, not an established SPIDER measurement.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): end-to-end agent cost is dominated by exploration, verification and repair, so honest counter-based work-avoided metrics (requests, calls, repairs) are preferable to wall-clock or stored-representation size.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. P2-REPLAY-COST (pre2 artifact 4.114, sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b) withdrew the 8.5x replay headline to 1.002x on matched tasks and mandates matched tasks plus fully loaded counterfactual costs; B1 asserts no cost quantity and cannot duplicate that claim. No artifact in the legacy index is a kernel-promotion/promotion-certificate experiment of this kind. Not a pointless rerun: prior Product packets tested economics and hit ceiling baselines; this one discharges a verified software blocker.
allocation.question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier be installed byte-identically at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py, with a binding pre-freeze positive/negative certificate whose confidence flow is not defeated by the literal distill() candidate confidence 0.5 versus the default resolve() execution threshold min_confidence 0.8, so that the shipped package (a) executes one known-positive inherited parameterized binding on an UNSEEN held-out identifier (distill_parameterized of three or more induction observations -> resolve EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action at confidence 0.9 -> deterministic fixture execute status 200 -> verify true), (b) refuses one known-negative family of unsafe bindings (out-of-support / missing-parameter / wrong-intent) with a recorded reason and a null bound action, returning exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN for the no-applicable-mechanism case, (c) keeps inherited-path counters honest, and (d) keeps the installed identity equal to the frozen carrier git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, thereby discharging blocker B1 and enabling promotion ONLY on independent audit PASS?
allocation.rationale: B1 is the first and cheapest of the three audit blockers and the only Product action that can be completed without a non-degenerate task bank or a capable agent. The in-flight PREFREEZE packet (EXP-PRODUCT-38114166950) is a software promotion and identity-pinning task: it makes no economics or transfer claim, so it neither violates the readiness gate nor risks another degenerate benchmark. The parent handoff (run the four-arm COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL/SPIDER benchmark) is superseded because conditions (2) and (3) are demonstrably absent. Once B1 passes independent audit, the next Product question becomes the first-party persistence economics (h(N), Cwrite, Cmiss on the shipped path) rather than the benchmark itself; that is deliberately deferred.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's only defensible product thesis is 'use audited reusable procedures and parameterized mechanisms, re-observe unstable values'. The cumulative audit (1,401 historical artifacts + 434 R2 packets) shows the substrate is bounded-validated (C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED only at the authorship-separated real-Chromium fixture scope) and that several inheritance mechanisms are live (C-PARAM-INHERIT EXPERIMENTAL: parameterized distill/resolve/execute ran 12/15 on credential-free localhost; C-FRESHNESS EXPERIMENTAL: extraction defect confirmed and replicated on 4 pinned anchors), but NO experiment yet shows a net end-to-end cost reduction per successful partially-novel Web task for a real external agent against strong cold/instructions/retrieval baselines. The flagship economic claim (C-PRODUCT-ECON / C-LLM-INHERIT) is triple-gated: (B1) the shipped src/spider/kernel.py still has no distill_parameterized and literal candidates at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 threshold; (B2) deterministic HTTP task banks put cold and retrieval at the 1.0 correctness ceiling (zero dynamic range); (B3) not one same-model/same-tools/same-budget four-arm trial is executable because the tested credential-free 3B/7B endpoints failed the minimal click-then-answer task 0/5. This cycle therefore allocates all six lanes to their most decision-relevant in-flight threads and deliberately does NOT fund the expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark, because none of the three readiness conditions holds in current accepted evidence. Product, Runtime and Intel continue on B1, B2 and B3 respectively, which is exactly the audit's prescribed concentration. Graph continues one design-contract-v2 attempt at the never-validly-measured confound-free C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE question (the three prior packets were MEASUREMENT_INVALID for a now-repaired control-plane defect plus non-discriminating controls), and is NOT sent back to the parked four-anchor C-FRESHNESS D1V route. Physics is mid-EXECUTE on an already-FROZEN C-WEB-DYNAMICS access-barrier stationarity packet and must complete before any redirection. Frontier continues the one repaired site-native-discovery attempt (v1 measured nothing on an empty sampling frame). Local-attractor flags are acknowledged on Runtime (68-streak), Graph (6-streak), Physics (4-streak) and the already-superseded tunnel status on Runtime/Graph; in every case the in-flight mandate is the anti-tunnel move already chosen, except Graph where a fresh-look comparison leaves the confound-free resolution question as the best available target. No lane is idle; no useful lane is left dormant. 255/434 REVISE+MEASUREMENT_INVALID is treated as a governance/reproducibility cost signal, and the standing instruction is repair-once (Runtime B2, Intel B3, control-plane v2) rather than re-purchase the same absence.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief is usable but partly degraded: its Codex-derived and general-knowledge findings are directionally correct and match my own reading of the snapshot (bounded C-MEAS-VALID, ceiling-degenerate benchmarks, unshipped carrier, unresolved prompt-vs-capability question), and it correctly identifies factory orchestration cost (255/434 REVISE/invalid) as a genuine liability. I adopted its central recommendation to concentrate Product/Runtime/Intel on the three gates and to treat Runtime's 68-streak C-MEAS-VALID tunnel as a counterfactual trigger rather than a quota. I DIVERGED on Graph: the Scout urged expanding C-FRESHNESS to a multi-anchor D1V population, but the audit and the lane's own parent handoff explicitly PARK the four-coupled-anchor Part II route, and the in-flight design-contract-v2 C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE packet targets the more decision-relevant, never-validly-measured joint-authorship confound; I kept Graph there. I also did not treat the Scout's framework/memory-landscape notes as SPIDER evidence. The Scout's stalled/idle table was checked against the snapshot: no lane is actually idle (all six have a live PREFREEZE/FROZEN experiment), so no reactivation beyond the existing in-flight mandates was warranted. Its orchestration-complexity question is answered by continuing repair-once (B1/B2/B3) rather than iterating the same prerequisites.

inherited_next_question: Now that the pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate is unsatisfiable on the mandatory-discovery deterministic credential-free REST substrate class (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED both at the 1.0 correctness ceiling at novelty >= 0.5 in families F1 and F2, so the parameterized treatment cannot save http_requests and the frozen cost/novelty test is non-discriminating), the materially orthogonal question is: on a programmatic, budget-stable, credential-free model endpoint (the prerequisite Intel showed is missing, EXP-INTEL-37973264582), can the frozen four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (same model/tools/budget: COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, with the parameterized mechanism carrier bound to git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) produce genuine behavioral variance (COLD success_rate meaningfully below the 1.0 ceiling) and, if so, does the SPIDER arm beat COLD, INSTRUCTIONS and RETRIEVAL on cost per SUCCESSFUL task on an honest counter-only metric (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, excluding latency_ms/1000)? If no such endpoint can be provisioned, the fallback is a credential-free substrate engineered for ASYMMETRIC discovery (multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks), tested against the same certificate and the same counter-only novelty-monotonicity criterion; a fourth re-run of the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate is explicitly excluded.
